title: class_weights
description: H13 decision — search/acceptance are `number` on purpose. JSON Schema has ONE number type, so this admits the integer 1 and the float 1.0 alike; weights are compared numerically (multiplied into score arithmetic), never by textual form, so narrowing to `type: integer` would be wrong and spelling `1.0` vs `1` is not a contract. Fixtures verified clean at the time of this decision: all 46 weight values in assets/taxonomy/class_weights.json are written as floats (1.0), all 23 provenance source_urls are non-empty strings of length >= 8 with no "null"-style placeholder, and 0 literal "null" strings appear anywhere in the file — so no fixture migration was needed and none was made. (Morph §7.3 later added the liveness family — chain-freeze, sequencer-halt, liveness — for 52 weight values and 26 provenance rows, same float/URL hygiene.) The minimum/maximum bounds ARE load-bearing (they bound a multiplier) and stay strict.
